method: Manual model/units/boundary reading plus independent standard-library arithmetic. Expressions and reported rounded values transcribed separately from course text; does not import author calculations. Numeric tolerance accommodates stated rounding; all displayed assumptions and boundaries also reviewed. Input hashes identify the reviewed snapshot. Later reviewed unit-text changes (model/mechanism/verification/failure) block report replacement unless manually rereviewed and explicitly accepted.
limits: Synthetic instructional examples only; not design certification or field validation.
Sources are not exhaustively reverified by this arithmetic review.
Automated comparisons do not parse prose for truth; the recorded model text and manual boundary notes are the actual reviewed scope.

reviewGuardValidation.method: In isolated temporary copies, separately change b126 unit 1 model and mechanism text; each rerun returns nonzero MANUAL REREVIEW REQUIRED and leaves the previous audit byte-for-byte unchanged.

boundaryFindings.issue: Joukowsky full pressure jump applies to sufficiently rapid velocity change relative to wave round-trip time; request this explicit limit in the model.
boundaryFindings.disposition: original author updated bilingual source and input; reviewed revised model and schema PASS

checks.title: 探測目標與盲區~Targets and blind zones
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Bore direction measured against target plane; inferred intercept is geometric.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance.

checks.title: 孔跡與角度誤差~Trajectory and angular error
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Angular alignment error; no assertion of actual bore deviation.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直孔100 m有1°方位偏差，末端側向差100 sin1°=1.745 m；這不是隨機誤差的標準差。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation.

checks.title: 鑽進比能辨識~Drilling specific energy
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Rotational work only; thrust and losses omitted.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設T=200 N·m、每轉進尺0.02 m、孔徑0.1 m，E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³，僅含旋轉功。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume T=200 N·m, penetration p=0.02 m/revolution and D=0.1 m. E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³, accounting only for rotational work.

checks.title: 岩屑輸送延遲~Cuttings transport lag
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Volume and steady return flow; transit delay is not unique geological attribution.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設回流容積0.15 m³、流量0.003 m³/s，平均延遲50 s；進尺0.01 m/s時深度偏移0.50 m。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed return volume 0.15 m³ and flow 0.003 m³/s, mean delay is 50 s; advancement at 0.01 m/s shifts assigned depth by 0.50 m.

checks.title: 返水流量收支~Return-flow balance
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Balance excludes storage correction and is not steady groundwater inflow.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設穩態供水20 L/min、返水27 L/min，淨流入7 L/min=0.117 L/s；未扣孔內儲存時不能稱穩態湧水量。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed steady supply of 20 L/min and return of 27 L/min imply net inflow 7 L/min=0.117 L/s; without a storage correction it is not steady groundwater inflow.

checks.title: 水頭與壓力換算~Head and pressure conversion
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Pressure head alone; elevation head must be added.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水ρ=1000 kg/m³、壓力490 kPa，壓力水頭p/(ρg)=49.95 m；總水頭另加測點高程。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed fresh water with ρ=1000 kg/m³ and p=490 kPa, pressure head p/(ρg)=49.95 m; add sensor elevation to obtain total head.

checks.title: 裂隙導水與尺度~Fracture flow and scale
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Darcy homogeneous idealization and specified hydraulic gradient.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Darcy條件k=10⁻⁶ m/s、面積2 m²、梯度5，Q=kAi=10⁻⁵ m³/s=0.01 L/s；裂隙慣性流不適用。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Darcy conditions with k=10⁻⁶ m/s, area 2 m² and gradient 5. Q=kAi=10⁻⁵ m³/s=0.01 L/s; inertial fracture flow falls outside this model.

checks.title: 多證據更新機率~Updating with multiple evidence
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Prior and false-positive definitions retained; not probability from signal alone.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設危險帶先驗0.2、靈敏度0.8、假陽性0.1，陽性後機率=0.16/(0.16+0.08)=0.667。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume prior hazard probability 0.2, sensitivity 0.8 and false-positive rate 0.1. Probability after a positive is 0.16/(0.16+0.08)=0.667.

checks.title: 取樣品質與回收~Sampling quality and recovery
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Core recovery does not assign location or strength of lost material.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設單回次長2.0 m、取回1.6 m，回收率=1.6/2.0=80%；遺失0.4 m仍需定位不確定性。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 2.0 m run with 1.6 m recovered, recovery is 80%; the missing 0.4 m retains positional uncertainty.

checks.title: 調查到開挖交接~Investigation-to-excavation handover
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Evidence completeness is not construction acceptance.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10項待回答地質問題中有8項獲獨立證據，證據完成率80%；其餘2項不能按平均分數判成通過。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If independent evidence addresses 8 of 10 assumed geological questions, evidence completion is 80%; the remaining 2 cannot be accepted through an average score.

checks.title: 阻抗反差與反射~Impedance contrast and reflection
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Normal-incidence impedance contrast; sign is phase, not energy fraction.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩側阻抗15與9 MRayl，正入射R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25；負號表示反相，非負能量。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed impedances of 15 and 9 MRayl, normal-incidence R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25; the sign indicates phase reversal, not negative energy.

checks.title: 走時與距離反演~Travel time and distance
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Two-way time; fixed time while velocity changes.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設正向反射v=4000 m/s、雙程t=0.040 s，d=vt/2=80 m；速度提高10%時距離為88 m。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume a frontal reflection with v=4000 m/s and two-way t=0.040 s. d=vt/2=80 m; increasing velocity by 10% gives 88 m.

checks.title: 頻率與分辨能力~Frequency and resolution
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Quarter wavelength is a scale, not guaranteed resolution.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設v=4000 m/s、f=1000 Hz，波長λ=4 m，四分之一波長尺度約1 m；它是簡化分辨尺度非保證。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed v=4000 m/s and f=1000 Hz, wavelength λ=4 m and a quarter-wavelength scale is about 1 m; this simplified scale is not a guarantee.

checks.title: 取樣與時間混疊~Sampling and time aliasing
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Ideal Nyquist limit is not an alias-safe working bandwidth.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設取樣頻率8000 Hz，Nyquist頻率4000 Hz，時間間隔0.125 ms；保留頻帶仍須低於理想上界。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At assumed sampling frequency 8000 Hz, the Nyquist frequency is 4000 Hz and interval 0.125 ms; the retained band must remain below the ideal boundary.

checks.title: 疊加與相關雜訊~Stacking and correlated noise
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Coherent repeated signals and independent zero-mean noise explicitly stated.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設16筆獨立等品質訊號疊加，振幅訊雜比提高√16=4倍，20log10(4)=12.04 dB。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Stacking an assumed 16 independent equal-quality records improves amplitude signal-to-noise ratio by √16=4, or 20log10(4)=12.04 dB.

checks.title: 測線幾何與偏移~Survey geometry and migration
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Azimuth uncertainty translated geometrically.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設反射距離80 m、方位不確定5°，橫向位置尺度80sin5°=6.97 m；不能只報里程誤差。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed reflector range 80 m and azimuth uncertainty 5°, lateral position scale is 80sin5°=6.97 m; chainage error alone is insufficient.

checks.title: 波速與彈性假設~Velocity and elastic assumptions
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Small-strain dynamic shear modulus, not static rock-mass modulus.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設ρ=2500 kg/m³、Vs=2000 m/s，Gdyn=ρVs²=10 GPa；Vs增加10%使Gdyn增加21%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed ρ=2500 kg/m³ and Vs=2000 m/s, Gdyn=ρVs²=10 GPa; a 10% rise in Vs raises Gdyn by 21%.

checks.title: 衰減與振幅混淆~Attenuation and amplitude ambiguity
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Material attenuation only; geometrical spreading excluded.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設純指數衰減A/A0=e^(−αx)，α=0.01 m⁻¹、x=50 m，比例e⁻⁰·⁵=0.607；未計擴散。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume purely exponential decay A/A0=e^(−αx), α=0.01 m⁻¹ and x=50 m. The ratio is e⁻⁰·⁵=0.607, excluding geometric spreading.

checks.title: 走時誤差傳播~Travel-time uncertainty propagation
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Independent velocity/time uncertainties; correlations require covariance.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設d=80 m、速度標準不確定5%、走時2%，獨立時ud=80√(0.05²+0.02²)=4.31 m。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume d=80 m with independent relative standard uncertainties of 5% in velocity and 2% in time; ud=80√(0.05²+0.02²)=4.31 m.

checks.title: 預測與揭露對照~Prediction and exposure comparison
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Sensitivity and false-positive denominator remain separate.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設已知10個異常中預測8個，靈敏度80%；另有20個正常區錯報3個，假陽性率15%，兩指標分列。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 8 of an assumed 10 anomalies are predicted, sensitivity is 80%; 3 false alarms among 20 normal intervals give 15% false-positive rate, reported separately.

checks.title: 回次與深度閉合~Runs and depth closure
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Lost length cannot be assigned to a particular depth without evidence.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鑽進3.0 m、岩心2.7 m，TCR=90%，缺失0.3 m；缺失所在深度仍不唯一。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed advance 3.0 m and recovered core 2.7 m, TCR=90% and loss=0.3 m; the location of that loss remains nonunique.

checks.title: 岩石品質指標~Rock quality designation
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Sound pieces and 100 mm counting convention; no standalone design classification.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設2 m回次內長度至少100 mm的健全岩心合計1.4 m，RQD=1.4/2×100=70%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If sound pieces at least 100 mm long total an assumed 1.4 m within a 2 m run, RQD=1.4/2×100=70%.

checks.title: 節理間距方向~Directional joint spacing
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Angle is to discontinuity normal, not to its plane.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設真法向間距0.3 m、測線與法線60°，表觀間距0.3/cos60°=0.6 m。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume normal spacing 0.3 m and a 60° angle between line and normal; apparent spacing is 0.3/cos60°=0.6 m.

checks.title: 節理表面與充填~Joint surfaces and infill
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Infill/asperity geometry is not a strength factor.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設填料厚4 mm、有效粗糙峰高2 mm，厚度比4/2=2；此幾何比不等於可直接使用的強度折減係數。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed infill thickness 4 mm and effective asperity height 2 mm, the ratio is 2; this geometric ratio is not a directly usable strength-reduction factor.

checks.title: 單軸強度與取樣~Uniaxial strength and sampling
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Intact specimen nominal stress, not rock-mass strength.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直徑50 mm試體破壞荷重200 kN，σ=P/(πD²/4)=101.9 MPa；不等於岩體強度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 50 mm diameter specimen failing at 200 kN gives σ=P/(πD²/4)=101.9 MPa; this is not rock-mass strength.

checks.title: 分類分項透明~Transparent classification components
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Illustrative score without claiming a code edition or design threshold.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設六個示範評分為12、15、10、20、7、−5，合計59；此加總練習不聲稱對應某版分類門檻。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed illustrative component scores of 12,15,10,20,7 and −5 total 59; this arithmetic exercise does not claim a threshold in a particular classification edition.

checks.title: 乘法指標敏感~Multiplicative index sensitivity
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Empirical index inputs and sensitivity, not measured capacity.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Q=(60/9)(2/3)(1/5)=0.889；若Jw由1降為0.5，其餘不變，Q=0.444。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed Q=(60/9)(2/3)(1/5)=0.889, reducing Jw from 1 to 0.5 while holding other factors fixed gives Q=0.444.

checks.title: 尺度與代表體積~Scale and representative volume
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Length and area scale cannot be applied as strength reduction.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設隧道直徑10 m、岩心直徑0.05 m，尺度比200；截面面積比200²=40000，不能據此直接縮減強度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed tunnel diameter 10 m and core diameter 0.05 m, length ratio is 200 and area ratio 40000; neither directly determines a strength reduction.

checks.title: 記錄者差異控制~Controlling logger differences
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Raw agreement is not chance-corrected kappa.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設20段中兩位記錄者有16段分類一致，原始一致率80%；它未扣除偶然一致，不能等同Kappa。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If two loggers agree on 16 of an assumed 20 intervals, raw agreement is 80%; without chance correction this is not a kappa statistic.

checks.title: 分類到模型交接~Classification-to-model handover
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Inferred proportion is not failure probability.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10個設計參數中6個實測、4個推估，推估比例40%；這是證據組成而非模型失敗機率。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 6 of an assumed 10 design parameters are measured and 4 inferred, the inferred fraction is 40%; this describes evidence composition, not model failure probability.

checks.title: 光學與聲學互補~Optical and acoustic complementarity
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Union computed from common interval and overlap.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100 m孔中光學可讀70 m、聲學可讀90 m，重疊可讀65 m，至少一種可讀為70+90−65=95 m。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 100 m hole, readable optical length 70 m, acoustic length 90 m and overlap 65 m give 95 m readable by at least one method.

checks.title: 展開影像與傾角~Unwrapped images and dip
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Vertical bore, planar trace, stated sinusoid half-amplitude.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鉛直孔直徑0.10 m、正弦半振幅0.05 m，tanδ=2A/D=1，δ=45°。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed vertical hole of diameter 0.10 m and sinusoidal half-amplitude 0.05 m, tanδ=2A/D=1 and δ=45°.

checks.title: 深度與速度校準~Depth and speed calibration
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Axial sample interval, not guaranteed feature resolution.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設移動速度0.05 m/s、掃描20行/s，垂直間距0.0025 m=2.5 mm；速度加倍則為5 mm。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At assumed travel speed 0.05 m/s and 20 scan lines/s, vertical spacing is 0.0025 m=2.5 mm; doubling speed makes it 5 mm.

checks.title: 磁方位與鋼材影響~Magnetic azimuth and steel effects
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Geometric effect of azimuth bias.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設投影長20 m、方位偏5°，側向誤差20sin5°=1.74 m；同一裂隙傾角可能仍看似正確。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed projected length 20 m and azimuth bias 5°, lateral error is 20sin5°=1.74 m even while the fracture dip appears correct.

checks.title: 孔徑與工具偏心~Caliper and tool eccentricity
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Defined ovality index; denominator explicitly selected.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩向孔徑110與100 mm，橢圓度(110−100)/100=10%；這是幾何指標而非應力比。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed orthogonal diameters 110 and 100 mm give ovality (110−100)/100=10%; this is a geometric index, not a stress ratio.

checks.title: 表觀裂隙開度~Apparent fracture aperture
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Apparent width and two-edge one-pixel worst-case allowance.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設像素尺度0.2 mm、暗帶3像素，表觀寬0.6 mm；若邊界各有1像素誤差，寬度誤差可達0.4 mm。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At an assumed pixel scale 0.2 mm, a 3-pixel band is 0.6 mm wide; one-pixel error at each boundary can change width by 0.4 mm.

checks.title: 裂隙組與取樣偏差~Joint sets and sampling bias
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Scanline frequency is not volumetric fracture density.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設可讀孔段20 m截交30條裂隙，線性密度1.5 m⁻¹；不經方向修正不能當體積裂隙密度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed readable 20 m interval intersects 30 fractures, linear intensity is 1.5 m⁻¹; it is not volumetric fracture density without orientation treatment.

checks.title: 導水裂隙交叉證據~Cross-evidence for conductive fractures
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Aligned steady flow readings; mixing or storage would invalidate attribution.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設某裂隙上下流量由0.20增至0.35 L/s，局部增量0.15 L/s；只有深度與穩態條件一致時可歸因。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed flow increase from 0.20 to 0.35 L/s across a fracture gives 0.15 L/s locally, attributable only with aligned depth and steady conditions.

checks.title: 自動判讀與盲查~Automated interpretation and blind checks
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Recall and precision have different definitions despite equal example values.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設人工確認20條裂隙，模型找到16條且另誤報4條，召回率16/20=80%，精確率16/(16+4)=80%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 20 confirmed fractures, 16 detections plus 4 false positives give recall 80% and precision 16/(16+4)=80%.

checks.title: 影像資料工程交接~Image-data engineering handover
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Traceability does not imply all missing observations are benign.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100條判釋裂隙中92條具完整原圖與校準鏈，追溯率92%；其餘8條需個別標示證據缺口。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 92 of an assumed 100 interpreted fractures have complete image and calibration chains, traceability is 92%; the other 8 need explicit individual evidence gaps.

checks.title: 覆土重量基準~Overburden stress baseline
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Overburden estimate omits topography/tectonics and nonuniform density.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均密度2600 kg/m³、深度500 m，σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa；未計地形與構造修正。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed mean density 2600 kg/m³ and depth 500 m, σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa, excluding topographic and tectonic corrections.

checks.title: 應力張量與主值~Stress tensor and principal values
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Two-dimensional principal values, not full 3D stress state.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平面σx=12、σy=8、τxy=3 MPa，主值10±√13，得13.61及6.39 MPa；未代表第三主值。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. checks.title: 有效應力與孔壓~Effective stress and pore pressure
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Biot coefficient and pressure reference defined.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設σ=15 MPa、u=3 MPa、α=0.8，σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa；若係數α=1則為12 MPa。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed σ=15 MPa, u=3 MPa and α=0.8, σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa; with α=1 it becomes 12 MPa.

checks.title: 套鑽應變回復~Overcoring strain relief

checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設單軸示意E=40 GPa、回復應變200 με，σ=Eε=8 MPa；實際多軸套鑽需完整校正矩陣。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed uniaxial illustration E=40 GPa and relieved strain 200 με, σ=Eε=8 MPa; real multiaxial overcoring requires a full calibration matrix.

checks.title: 水力破裂壓力判讀~Hydraulic-fracture pressure interpretation
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Static water-column correction; flow losses excluded.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設地表讀值8 MPa、測段低100 m且水密度1000 kg/m³，靜水修正0.981 MPa，井下8.981 MPa；未計流動損失。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume surface pressure 8 MPa and an interval 100 m lower with water density 1000 kg/m³; static correction 0.981 MPa gives 8.981 MPa downhole, excluding flowing losses.

checks.title: 孔壁崩落與方位~Borehole breakouts and orientation
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Author clarified free-wall, homogeneous isotropic elastic medium and hole axis along third principal direction after review.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設線彈性均質等向岩、無內壓自由圓孔壁，孔軸沿第三主應力方向；遠場主水平應力20與10 MPa，最大環向壓應力3×20−10=50 MPa。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity, a traction-free circular wall without internal pressure, and borehole axis along the third principal direction; horizontal principal stresses 20 and 10 MPa give maximum hoop compression 50 MPa.

checks.title: 彈性各向異性~Elastic anisotropy
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Sensitivity to assumed modulus, not a complete anisotropic solution.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設同一100 με在兩向模數20與40 GPa下，單軸示意應力分別2與4 MPa；並非完整各向異性解。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed strain 100 με and directional moduli 20 and 40 GPa, uniaxial illustrative stresses are 2 and 4 MPa, not a full anisotropic solution.

checks.title: 開挖擾動與距離~Excavation disturbance and distance
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: One radial scaling term, not the complete stress solution.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設圓孔彈性影響項比例a²/r²，a=5 m、r=15 m時為1/9=0.111；只是幾何衰減項，不是完整應力。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed circular-opening elastic term a²/r² with a=5 m and r=15 m, the term is 1/9=0.111; it is not the complete stress solution.

checks.title: 反演殘差與不確定~Inversion residuals and uncertainty
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: RMSE without removing common bias; not proof of identifiability.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個應變殘差3、−4、0 με，RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με；此值不含共同零點偏移。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed strain residuals 3,−4 and 0 με, RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με; this excludes a shared zero offset.

checks.title: 應力模型工程移交~Engineering stress-model handover
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Mean and range; no normal-distribution claim.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三測點最大主應力18、22、26 MPa，平均22 MPa、範圍8 MPa；小樣本不能據此宣稱全場正態分布。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed maximum principal stresses 18,22 and 26 MPa have mean 22 MPa and range 8 MPa; this small sample does not establish a site-wide normal distribution.

checks.title: 法向應力與摩擦~Normal stress and friction
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Zero-cohesion effective normal stress 1 MPa and selected angles.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設c=0、σn′=1 MPa、φ=35°，τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa；摩擦角φ降25°時為0.466 MPa。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume c=0, σn′=1 MPa and φ=35°; τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa, falling to 0.466 MPa at φ=25°.

checks.title: 孔壓與有效法向力~Pore pressure and effective normal force
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Effective normal stress and drained friction relation.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設σn=1.2 MPa、u=0.4 MPa，σn′=0.8 MPa；摩擦角φ=30°時抗剪應力τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed σn=1.2 MPa and u=0.4 MPa, σn′=0.8 MPa; at φ=30°, τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa.

checks.title: 定力與定剛度邊界~Constant-load and stiffness boundaries
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Prescribed normal stiffness; machine compliance excluded.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設法向剛度kn=2 MPa/mm、剪脹0.3 mm，Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa；未計設備柔度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed normal stiffness kn=2 MPa/mm and dilation 0.3 mm, Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa, excluding machine compliance.

checks.title: 剪脹與幾何攀升~Dilation and geometric climbing
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Dilation displacement ratio, not direct friction angle.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設剪移2 mm產生法向增量0.2 mm，ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°；此為該段平均角。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 2 mm shear displacement produces 0.2 mm normal movement; ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°, averaged only over that interval.

checks.title: 峰值與殘餘強度~Peak and residual resistance
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Peak-to-residual drop is not a factor of safety.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設峰值0.9 MPa、殘餘0.5 MPa，峰後降幅(0.9−0.5)/0.9=44.4%；不是安全係數。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed peak and residual stresses of 0.9 and 0.5 MPa give a post-peak drop of 44.4%; this is not a factor of safety.

checks.title: 剪切面積修正~Shearing-area correction
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Overlap correction for assumed planar shear specimen.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設矩形100×100 mm試件剪移10 mm，重疊9000 mm²；剪力9 kN對應1.0 MPa，初始面積算法為0.9 MPa。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 100×100 mm specimen displaced 10 mm has 9000 mm² overlap; 9 kN gives 1.0 MPa instead of 0.9 MPa using initial area.

checks.title: 速率與排水時間~Rate and drainage time
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Diffusion timescale only; boundary-dependent consolidation solution omitted.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設特徵排水距離5 mm、cv=10⁻⁸ m²/s，t=L²/cv=2500 s約41.7 min；此為尺度估算。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed drainage length 5 mm and cv=10⁻⁸ m²/s, t=L²/cv=2500 s, about 41.7 min; this is a scaling estimate.

checks.title: 粗糙度與尺度差~Roughness and scale dependence
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Relative roughness is geometry, not direct strength scaling.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設同高程差2 mm在10與100 mm基長上，平均坡度分別0.2與0.02；尺度改變使表觀坡度差10倍。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 2 mm height change over 10 and 100 mm baselines gives slopes 0.2 and 0.02, a tenfold apparent difference caused by scale.

checks.title: 量測誤差與強度~Measurement error and strength
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Independent first-order force and area uncertainty.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設力標準不確定2%、面積3%，獨立小誤差下應力相對不確定√(0.02²+0.03²)=3.61%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume independent small standard uncertainties of 2% in force and 3% in area; relative stress uncertainty is √(0.02²+0.03²)=3.61%.

checks.title: 剪切功與試後證據~Shear work and post-test evidence
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Work per nominal area; not all energy necessarily dissipated.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均剪應力0.6 MPa、滑移5 mm，W/A=τδ=3000 J/m²；未分離可回復儲能。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed mean shear stress 0.6 MPa and slip 5 mm, W/A=τδ=3000 J/m², without separating recoverable stored energy.

checks.title: 沉陷槽形與參數~Settlement-trough geometry
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Gaussian settlement illustration with downward-positive convention.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Smax=10 mm、i=5 m，x=5 m處S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm；假設沉陷向下為正。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Smax=10 mm and i=5 m; at x=5 m, S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm, taking downward settlement as positive.

checks.title: 體積損失換算~Volume-loss conversion
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Trough volume per length compared to excavation area; not actual loss causality.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Smax=0.01 m、i=5 m，Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m²；直徑6 m面積28.274 m²，VL=0.443%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Smax=0.01 m and i=5 m; Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m². A 6 m diameter gives area 28.274 m² and VL=0.443%.

checks.title: 穩定基準與閉合~Stable benchmarks and closure
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: External reference needed to recover benchmark movement.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設觀測點讀得下沉8 mm，基準本身下沉3 mm，真實相對外部穩定基準沉陷為11 mm。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed point appears to settle 8 mm relative to a benchmark that itself settles 3 mm, settlement relative to a stable external datum is 11 mm.

checks.title: 差異沉陷與傾斜~Differential movement and tilt
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Small angular distortion; no universal damage threshold.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩支點距10 m、高差5 mm，角變化Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000；非通用損害門檻。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed support spacing 10 m and differential movement 5 mm, Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000; this is not a universal damage threshold.

checks.title: 速率與時間窗~Rates and time windows
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Time windows remain explicit and comparable.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設24 h沉陷增加2 mm，平均速率0.0833 mm/h；若同變化集中在2 h則局部平均1 mm/h。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 2 mm increase over 24 h averages 0.0833 mm/h; if concentrated within 2 h, the local average is 1 mm/h.

checks.title: 精度與差值不確定~Precision of displacement differences
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Independent epoch errors; shared datum bias does not cancel automatically.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩次高程各標準不確定0.5 mm且獨立，差值u=√(0.5²+0.5²)=0.707 mm。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assuming independent elevation standard uncertainties of 0.5 mm at each epoch, the difference has u=√(0.5²+0.5²)=0.707 mm.

checks.title: 地下水下降與固結~Drawdown and consolidation
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Total stress held constant and measured pore-head fall specified.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總應力不變且測點孔壓降低γwΔh，水頭降2 m使Δσ′=9.81×2=19.62 kPa；總重改變須另算。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume total stress remains fixed and point pore pressure falls by γwΔh; a 2 m head drop gives Δσ′=19.62 kPa, requiring separate treatment if total weight changes.

checks.title: 施工里程與多源事件~Chainage and multiple events
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Reference face distance and diameter only, sign convention retained.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設掌子面距測點30 m、隧道直徑6 m，規一化距離x/D=5；兩條線比較需同樣定義正負方向。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed face distance 30 m and diameter 6 m, normalized distance x/D=5; comparing drives requires the same sign convention.

checks.title: 警戒邏輯與量測確認~Trigger logic and measurement confirmation
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Illustrative review ratio, not authorization or code limit.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設教學警戒比r=量測8 mm/審查值10 mm=0.8；此10 mm純為算例，現場需個案核准。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed teaching trigger ratio is measured 8 mm/review value 10 mm=0.8; the 10 mm value is purely illustrative and requires project-specific approval in practice.

checks.title: 長期追蹤與結案~Long-term tracking and closeout
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Decreasing increments do not prove zero future movement.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設連續四週增量0.8、0.4、0.2、0.1 mm，總增量1.5 mm；遞減趨勢不等於未來必定為零。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed weekly increments 0.8,0.4,0.2 and 0.1 mm total 1.5 mm; a decreasing trend does not prove zero future movement.

checks.title: 收斂弦長與方向~Convergence chords and direction
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Chord contraction excludes common translation.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設原弦長8.000 m、後為7.988 m，收斂12 mm、相對應變12/8000=0.0015。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed chord shortening from 8.000 to 7.988 m gives convergence 12 mm and relative strain 12/8000=0.0015.

checks.title: 初始讀值與已發生變形~Initial readings and prior movement
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Pre-baseline displacement is inferred and separately identified.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設首讀前已收斂6 mm、之後量得14 mm，總估計20 mm；缺失初期量占30%，須明列為推估。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 6 mm convergence before the first reading and 14 mm afterward; estimated total is 20 mm, with 30% explicitly inferred rather than measured.

checks.title: 角度精度與觀測距離~Angular precision and sight distance
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Small-angle transverse scale, not full survey error budget.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設視距100 m、角度誤差5 arcsec，線性誤差100×5/206265=0.00242 m=2.42 mm。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed sight distance 100 m and angular error 5 arcsec, linear error is 100×5/206265=0.00242 m=2.42 mm.

checks.title: 鋼尺溫度與張力~Tape temperature and tension
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Uniform thermal expansion; sag and restraint omitted.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鋼尺α=12×10⁻⁶/K、長10 m、溫差10 K，ΔL=αLΔT=1.2 mm；未含垂度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume steel-tape α=12×10⁻⁶/K, length 10 m and temperature change 10 K; ΔL=1.2 mm, excluding sag.

checks.title: 參考點穩定與共模~Reference stability and common motion
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Common translation preserves chord lengths while absolute position changes.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三點皆向右5 mm且弦長不變，可能為共同平移；差分位移5−5=0 mm，不能據此宣稱絕對不動。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If three assumed targets all move 5 mm right with unchanged chords, their differential movement is zero; this does not demonstrate absolute stability.

checks.title: 面距與變形速率~Face distance and movement rate
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Time and advance-normalized rates are distinct.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設收斂由8增至11 mm歷時6 h，平均0.5 mm/h；同期面進3 m，空間增率1 mm/m。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed convergence increase from 8 to 11 mm over 6 h gives 0.5 mm/h; with 3 m advance, the spatial increment is 1 mm/m.

checks.title: 支護接觸與剛度~Support contact and stiffness
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Linear post-contact support response only.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設等效線性支護k=20 MN/m、接觸後位移2 mm，反力F=kδ=40 kN；接觸前不可使用此式。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume equivalent linear support stiffness k=20 MN/m and post-contact movement 2 mm; F=kδ=40 kN, inapplicable before contact.

checks.title: 斷面橢圓化模式~Section ovalization patterns
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Defined diameter difference, not a universal ovality criterion.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設水平直徑6.000變5.990 m、垂直變6.006 m，差異橢圓化幅16 mm；定義須固定。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume horizontal diameter changes from 6.000 to 5.990 m while vertical becomes 6.006 m; the diameter difference is 16 mm under this stated ovalization definition.

checks.title: 資料延遲與回應~Data latency and response
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Serial worst-case latency, excluding remeasurement and other delays.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設採樣5 min、傳輸延遲10 min、審查15 min，最壞單次等待尺度為30 min；未含重測時間。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume sampling interval 5 min, transmission delay 10 min and review 15 min; a worst-case single-cycle waiting scale is 30 min, excluding remeasurement.

checks.title: 收斂反分析與交接~Convergence back-analysis and handover
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Equal residuals for two models do not establish equal mechanisms.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設模型A與B都預測10 mm但實測10.5 mm，兩者殘差皆0.5 mm；相同擬合誤差不能證明機制相同。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If assumed models A and B predict 10 mm against 10.5 mm observed, both residuals are 0.5 mm; equal fit error does not establish the same mechanism.

checks.title: 像素尺度與可見細節~Pixel scale and visible detail
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Ground sampling distance is not 3D reconstruction accuracy.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設距離5 m、像素5 μm、焦距25 mm，GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel；非三維精度保證。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume range 5 m, pixel pitch 5 μm and focal length 25 mm; GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel, not a guarantee of three-dimensional accuracy.

checks.title: 立體基線與深度~Stereo baseline and depth
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Ideal stereo propagation with fixed calibrated geometry.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Z=5 m、f=5000 pixel、B=1 m、視差誤差0.5 pixel，σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Z=5 m, f=5000 pixels, B=1 m and disparity error 0.5 pixel; σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm.

checks.title: 相機校準與畸變~Camera calibration and distortion
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Specified radial-distortion coefficient and pixel convention.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設徑向畸變模型Δr=k1r³，r=1000 pixel、k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻²，Δr=1 pixel；單位須一致。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed radial distortion Δr=k1r³ with r=1000 pixels and k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻², Δr=1 pixel; units must remain consistent.

checks.title: 尺度與控制點布置~Scale and control distribution
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Global scaling cannot repair local warping.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設真實標距2.000 m被重建為1.990 m，尺度修正2.000/1.990=1.00503；仍不能修正局部翹曲。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed true distance 2.000 m reconstructed as 1.990 m requires scale factor 1.00503; that factor cannot correct local warping.

checks.title: 照明與濕壁反光~Lighting and wet-wall reflections
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Saturated-pixel count is not usable measurement coverage.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設影像有200萬有效岩面像素，其中20萬過曝，過曝率10%；不能將其插值面視為直接量測。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed 2000000 face pixels include 200000 saturated pixels, saturation is 10%; interpolated surfaces there are not direct measurements.

checks.title: 遮擋與可見範圍~Occlusion and visible coverage
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Occluded area remains missing rather than inferred as sound.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設掌子面50 m²中實際重建42 m²，可見重建率84%；餘8 m²不能按平均表面直接補成穩定。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 50 m² face with 42 m² reconstructed, coverage is 84%; the remaining 8 m² cannot be filled with an average surface and declared stable.

checks.title: 重投影與獨立精度~Reprojection versus independent accuracy
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Checkpoint RMSE differs from maximum error and training fit.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個檢核誤差1、2、2 mm，RMSE=√((1+4+4)/3)=1.73 mm；不等於最大誤差。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed checkpoint errors 1,2 and 2 mm, RMSE=√((1+4+4)/3)=1.73 mm; this is not the maximum error.

checks.title: 節理平面與法向~Joint planes and normals
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Unit normal and vertical reference stated.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平面法向量(0,0.6,0.8)已單位化，與鉛直夾角acos0.8=36.87°，即此平面傾角。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed unit normal (0,0.6,0.8), angle to vertical acos0.8=36.87° gives the plane dip under this convention.

checks.title: 重複測量與變化偵測~Repeat surveys and change detection
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Independent Gaussian epoch errors for stated 95 percent illustration.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩期表面標準不確定各2 mm且獨立，差值u=2.83 mm；約95%正態尺度1.96u=5.54 mm。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume independent surface uncertainties of 2 mm per epoch; difference u=2.83 mm and an approximate 95% normal scale is 1.96u=5.54 mm.

checks.title: 模型證據與安全交接~Model evidence and safe handover
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Missing datum can invalidate a high-completeness dataset.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10項交接資料有9項齊備，完整率90%；缺少坐標基準這1項仍可使整個模型不可整合。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 9 of an assumed 10 handover items are complete, completeness is 90%; one missing coordinate datum can still make the entire model unusable for integration.

checks.title: 總應力與有效應力~Total and effective stress
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Effective stress illustration, not face support setting.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總法向應力300 kPa、孔壓180 kPa，有效應力120 kPa；這只是應力分解，不是支護壓力設定。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed total normal stress 300 kPa and pore pressure 180 kPa give effective stress 120 kPa; this is decomposition, not a support-pressure setting.

checks.title: 壓力梯度與高度~Pressure gradient with height
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Hydrostatic head term alone does not establish stability range.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設介質密度1500 kg/m³、垂直高差6 m，Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa；非整面穩定所需壓差。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed medium density 1500 kg/m³ and vertical difference 6 m, Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa; this is not the required stability-pressure range.

checks.title: 覆土與上舉邊界~Cover and uplift boundaries
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Simple overburden ignores arching, water and cohesion.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設均質覆土重度18 kN/m³、厚8 m，自重應力144 kPa；此量級檢查未計拱效應、黏聚或水。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed uniform cover unit weight 18 kN/m³ over 8 m gives 144 kPa overburden; this scale check excludes arching, cohesion and water.

checks.title: 不排水穩定比值~Undrained stability index
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Illustrative load-to-undrained-strength ratio, no universal threshold.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設荷載差150 kPa、su=50 kPa，示意N=150/50=3；此值未提供任何通用合格門檻。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed load difference 150 kPa and su=50 kPa, illustrative N=3; no universal acceptance threshold is implied.

checks.title: 砂土滲流與濾膜~Sand seepage and filter cake
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Ideal critical-gradient relation not a tunnel-face design criterion.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設孔隙比e=0.7、Gs=2.65，理想向上滲流臨界梯度ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971；非掌子面設計門檻。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume void ratio e=0.7 and Gs=2.65; ideal upward-seepage critical gradient ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971, not a face-design threshold.

checks.title: 體積平衡與失土~Volume balance and ground loss
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: In-situ geometry; fluid and bulking must be reconciled separately.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直徑6 m、前進1.5 m，理論體積πD²L/4=42.41 m³；出土差額須先校正添加量與鬆脹。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume diameter 6 m and advance 1.5 m; theoretical volume πD²L/4=42.41 m³, with discharge differences corrected for additions and bulking first.

checks.title: 停機與壓力演變~Standstill and pressure evolution
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Assumed exponential transient, not a calibrated field forecast.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設教學一階衰減p(t)=p0e^(−t/τ)，p0=200 kPa、τ=10 h，2 h後163.7 kPa；非現場預測。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed teaching decay p(t)=p0e^(−t/τ), p0=200 kPa and τ=10 h give 163.7 kPa after 2 h; this is not a field prediction.

checks.title: 混合地層與面內差異~Mixed ground across the face
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Sand area fraction is not a risk probability.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設面積30 m²中6 m²為高透水砂，比例20%；面積小不代表其對滲流風險只貢獻20%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed 30 m² face contains 6 m² permeable sand, its area fraction is 20%; its seepage-risk contribution is not necessarily only 20%.

checks.title: 模型敏感度與可靠性~Model sensitivity and reliability
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Strength sensitivity, not probability of failure.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設示意指標N=150/su，su由50降40 kPa時N由3增至3.75，增加25%；不是失敗機率。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed illustrative N=150/su, lowering su from 50 to 40 kPa increases N from 3 to 3.75, or 25%; this is not a failure probability.

checks.title: 證據整合與審查界線~Evidence integration and review boundaries
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: An anomalous fifth record cannot be overruled by majority.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設5類證據中4類正常、1類持續異常，正常比例80%；不得以多數決取消異常的獨立調查。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 4 of an assumed 5 evidence streams appear normal and 1 remains abnormal, 80% normality cannot overrule independent investigation of the anomaly.

checks.title: 塑性土塞的功能~Function of the plastic soil plug
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Observed mean pressure gradient, not equipment setting.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設螺旋機長8 m、兩端壓差160 kPa，平均梯度20 kPa/m；僅描述量測，不是允許設定。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume an 8 m screw with a 160 kPa end-to-end pressure difference; the mean gradient is 20 kPa/m, describing a measurement rather than an operating setting.

checks.title: 含水率基準轉換~Moisture-basis conversion
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Dry-mass water content distinguished from wet-mass fraction.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設乾土1000 kg、水250 kg，w=25%；水占濕土1250 kg的比例為20%，兩者不可混用。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume dry soil 1000 kg and water 250 kg; moisture content is 25%, while water is 20% of the 1250 kg wet mass.

checks.title: 泡沫體積與壓縮~Foam volume and compression
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Absolute pressure and ideal isothermal gas only.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設等溫理想氣體由絕對壓100增至300 kPa，初始氣體3 m³縮至1 m³；液相體積未計。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume isothermal ideal gas compressed from absolute 100 to 300 kPa; 3 m³ becomes 1 m³, excluding liquid volume.

checks.title: 粒徑與細料作用~Grading and fines behavior
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Specified sieve convention, not a universal recipe.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設乾樣2 kg中通過指定篩0.6 kg，細料比例30%；篩孔尺寸必須一併註明。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 2 kg dry sample with 0.6 kg passing a specified sieve, fines content is 30%; the sieve aperture must accompany the value.

checks.title: 流變屈服與黏度~Yield stress and viscosity
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Ideal Bingham parameters with shear-rate units.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Bingham示意τy=2 kPa、μp=0.5 kPa·s、剪率4 s⁻¹，τ=τy+μpγ̇=4 kPa。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed Bingham values τy=2 kPa, μp=0.5 kPa·s and shear rate 4 s⁻¹, τ=τy+μpγ̇=4 kPa.

checks.title: 扭矩功率與能耗~Torque power and energy
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Rotational shaft power, not installed equipment rating.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設扭矩1 MN·m、轉速2 rpm，P=T×2πn/60=209.4 kW；非額定能力或推薦轉速。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed torque 1 MN·m and speed 2 rpm, P=T×2πn/60=209.4 kW; these are neither ratings nor recommended settings.

checks.title: 添加收支與混合均勻~Addition balance and mixing uniformity
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Volume ratio is an illustrative observation, not conditioning instruction.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設一段原土40 m³加入液體2 m³，體積比5%；此示意不指定任何材料配方。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 2 m³ of liquid added to 40 m³ of original ground gives a 5% ratio; this illustration specifies no material recipe.

checks.title: 滲透與壓力保持~Permeability and pressure retention
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Darcy assumptions, particular geometry and gradient.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設k=10⁻⁷ m/s、面積0.01 m²、梯度10，Q=10⁻⁸ m³/s=0.0006 L/min，需足夠量測靈敏度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume k=10⁻⁷ m/s, area 0.01 m² and gradient 10; Q=10⁻⁸ m³/s=0.0006 L/min, requiring sufficient sensitivity.

checks.title: 老化與環境相容~Aging and environmental compatibility
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Arbitrary test-index retention, not specification acceptance.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設同法試驗初始流動指標100、2 h後80，保留比例80%；這是任意指標示例而非材料規格。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed identical-method flow index falling from 100 to 80 after 2 h has 80% retention; this arbitrary index is not a material specification.

checks.title: 改良試驗到現場移交~Conditioning trials and field handover
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Failed trials remain in denominator.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設12組試驗中8組符合預定雙重功能要求，比例66.7%；其餘4組仍需保留原因，不能刪除。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 8 of an assumed 12 trials satisfy predefined dual-function requirements, the proportion is 66.7%; retain reasons for the other 4 rather than deleting them.

checks.title: 循環系統與控制邊界~Circuit and control boundaries
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Unchanged storage; net return includes fluid and solids.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water.

checks.title: 流速與顆粒輸送~Velocity and solids transport
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Mean velocity only, not transport recommendation.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設流量0.25 m³/s、管徑0.4 m，v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s；非推薦輸送速度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed Q=0.25 m³/s and D=0.4 m, v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s; this is not a recommended transport speed.

checks.title: 壓差與泵浦功率~Pressure loss and pump power
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Hydraulic power divided by pump efficiency; motor losses omitted.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Q=0.2 m³/s、Δp=500 kPa、效率0.75，軸功率QΔp/η=133.3 kW；未含馬達損失。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Q=0.2 m³/s, Δp=500 kPa and efficiency 0.75; shaft power QΔp/η=133.3 kW, excluding motor losses.

checks.title: 固體質量濃度~Solids mass concentration
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Two-component volume and mass fractions are distinguished.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設ρm=1200、ρw=1000、ρs=2600 kg/m³，Cv=(1200−1000)/(2600−1000)=0.125；質量分率0.271。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume ρm=1200, ρw=1000 and ρs=2600 kg/m³; Cv=0.125 and solids mass fraction Cvρs/ρm=0.271.

checks.title: 旋流分離與分級~Cyclone separation and grading
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Overall solids recovery does not establish each particle-size fraction.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設進料乾固體100 t/h、底流回收80 t/h，總質量回收80%；不等於所有粒徑皆有80%分離率。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed dry-solids feed 100 t/h and underflow recovery 80 t/h, overall recovery is 80%; this does not mean 80% capture at every size.

checks.title: 槽位與停留時間~Tank levels and residence time
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Nominal residence time differs from actual residence-time distribution.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設有效槽容60 m³、流量120 m³/h，名義停留0.5 h=30 min；非完整停留時間分布。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed effective volume 60 m³ and flow 120 m³/h, nominal residence time is 0.5 h=30 min, not the full residence-time distribution.

checks.title: 壓力暫態與管路彈性~Pressure transients and pipe elasticity
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Author clarified velocity change fast relative to 2L/a and excluded direct application to slow changes after review.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設變速時間比往返波傳時間2L/a短，示意ρ=1200 kg/m³、a=300 m/s、Δv=0.5 m/s，Δp=ρaΔv=180 kPa；慢變速不直接適用。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume velocity changes faster than the round-trip wave time 2L/a; illustrative ρ=1200 kg/m³, a=300 m/s and Δv=0.5 m/s give Δp=180 kPa. Slow changes do not directly satisfy this relation.

checks.title: 磨耗與剩餘厚度~Wear and remaining thickness
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Observed average rate, extrapolation only under unchanged conditions.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設某點厚度由12降10 mm歷時1000 h，平均磨耗0.002 mm/h；線性外推只在同工況下作情境比較。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed point thinning from 12 to 10 mm over 1000 h averages 0.002 mm/h; linear extrapolation is only a same-condition scenario.

checks.title: 循環可靠度與備援~Circuit availability and redundancy
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Operational availability denominator, not intrinsic reliability.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設運轉160 h、停機10 h，利用率160/170=94.12%；不是單一元件固有可靠度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed operation 160 h and downtime 10 h, availability is 160/170=94.12%; it is not an intrinsic component reliability.

checks.title: 泥水資料與工程結案~Slurry-data engineering closeout
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Critical uncalibrated measurement requires resolution regardless of percentage.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10個流量感測器中9個具完整校準鏈，追溯率90%；關鍵回流計缺失仍須個別處理。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 9 of an assumed 10 flowmeters have complete calibration chains, traceability is 90%; a missing critical return meter still requires individual resolution.

checks.title: 多道刷列的阻水機制~Multiple brush-row sealing
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Independent barriers only; common causes explicitly invalidate product.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 3 independent barriers each with failure probability 0.01; simultaneous failure is 10⁻⁶, but real common causes invalidate independence.

checks.title: 尾隙與偏心分布~Tail clearance and eccentricity
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Opposite eccentric clearances, ovalization excluded.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設名義徑向間隙40 mm、偏心15 mm，兩側示意間隙25與55 mm；未含橢圓化。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed nominal radial clearance 40 mm and eccentricity 15 mm, opposite clearances are 25 and 55 mm, excluding ovalization.

checks.title: 密封壓差與高程~Seal differential pressure and elevation
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Freshwater hydrostatic pressure excludes grout transient and supply setting.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水高差30 m，靜水壓差ρgh=294.3 kPa；它不含灌漿暫態且非密封供壓指令。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed fresh-water elevation difference of 30 m gives 294.3 kPa hydrostatic pressure, excluding grout transients and not prescribing seal supply pressure.

checks.title: 密封消耗與有效補充~Consumption and effective replenishment
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Zero-advance standstill denominator is undefined.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設一段消耗120 kg、前進8 m，單位消耗15 kg/m；另一停機時段不能以零進尺計此比值。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed consumption 120 kg over 8 m gives 15 kg/m; the same ratio is undefined for a zero-advance standstill.

checks.title: 流變與輸送相容~Rheology and delivery compatibility
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Line pressure-loss ratio is not a sealing-capacity ratio.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設管線同流量下壓降由1.0增1.5 MPa，比值1.5；不能直接斷定密封能力也增加50%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If assumed line loss rises from 1.0 to 1.5 MPa at equal flow, the ratio is 1.5; sealing ability has not thereby increased by 50%.

checks.title: 環片表面與接觸~Segment surface and contact
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Continuous local defect cannot be risk-averaged by circumference share.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設周長20 m中有0.5 m表面缺陷帶，占2.5%；局部連續缺陷不能按面積比例平均風險。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 0.5 m defect band along a 20 m circumference is 2.5%; a continuous local defect cannot have its risk averaged by that fraction.

checks.title: 灌漿與密封交互作用~Grouting and seal interaction
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Diagnostic signed pressure difference, not allowable margin.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設外部灌漿壓力250 kPa、局部密封腔讀值230 kPa，差20 kPa；此差值只供診斷，非容許界線。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed external grout pressure 250 kPa and local cavity reading 230 kPa differ by 20 kPa; the difference is diagnostic, not an allowable boundary.

checks.title: 漏水量與趨勢判讀~Leakage rate and trend interpretation
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Dedicated collection required; mixed drainage cannot isolate leakage.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設專用收集槽5 min增加30 L，平均漏量6 L/min=0.1 L/s；未分流總排水不適用。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed dedicated tank gaining 30 L in 5 min indicates 6 L/min=0.1 L/s; mixed drainage cannot support the same attribution.

checks.title: 停機保存與劣化~Standstill preservation and deterioration
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Observation does not establish replenishment schedule.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設停機24 h消耗36 kg，平均1.5 kg/h；此觀測不能轉成通用補充週期或允許停機時限。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed 36 kg consumption during a 24 h standstill averages 1.5 kg/h; it does not prescribe a universal replenishment interval or allowable stop duration.

checks.title: 密封狀態工程移交~Seal-condition engineering handover
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Adjacent missing zones are not uniform random omissions.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設12個監測分區有9個完整資料，覆蓋75%；缺失3區若相鄰，不能視為均勻隨機缺測。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 9 of an assumed 12 zones have complete records, coverage is 75%; 3 adjacent missing zones are not uniformly random omissions.

checks.title: 刀具半徑與行程~Cutter radius and travel
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Tangential speed at stated radius, not recommended rotation.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設刀位半徑5 m、轉速4 rpm，切向速度v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s；不代表建議轉速。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume cutter radius 5 m and rotation 4 rpm; tangential speed v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s, not a recommended speed.

checks.title: 貫入與每轉進尺~Penetration per revolution

checks.title: 磨耗率與地層分段~Wear rate by geological reach

checks.title: 刀具身份與維修追溯~Tool identity and maintenance traceability

checks.title: 材料批次與強度~Material batches and strength

checks.title: 防火與爆裂驗證~Fire and spalling verification

checks.title: 環片序號與品質交接~Segment serials and quality handover
