checks.title: 環片浮力與抬升~Lining buoyancy and uplift
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Author clarified near-hydrostatic external pressure and effective displaced grout volume, not concrete volume; revised model reread.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設外壓近似靜水分布，有效排開漿體體積15 m³（非混凝土體積）、密度1200 kg/m³，浮力176.58 kN；環重12 t為117.72 kN，未計約束淨上力58.86 kN。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume near-hydrostatic external pressure and effective displaced grout volume of 15 m³, not concrete volume, at 1200 kg/m³; buoyancy is 176.58 kN. A 12 t ring weighs 117.72 kN, leaving 58.86 kN before restraints.

checks.title: 早齡剛度與荷載接替~Early stiffness and load transfer
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Linear compressive stiffness illustration, not failure strength.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設等效壓縮模數50 MPa、應變0.001，線彈性示意應力0.05 MPa=50 kPa；不代表破壞強度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume compression modulus 50 MPa and strain 0.001; illustrative elastic stress is 0.05 MPa=50 kPa, not failure strength.

checks.title: 收縮與失水容積~Shrinkage and volume loss
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Free volumetric reduction does not automatically become a restrained field void.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設初始填充3 m³、自由體積縮減2%，變化0.06 m³；現地是否成空洞取決於補給與約束。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume initial fill 3 m³ and free volumetric reduction 2%; change is 0.06 m³, with field void formation dependent on replenishment and restraint.

checks.title: 空洞檢測與非唯一性~Void detection and nonuniqueness
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Unmeasured area remains unknown, not defect-free.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100 m²檢查面中10 m²無有效資料，可評估覆蓋90%；未量區不能併入無缺陷面積。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed 100 m² inspection area includes 10 m² without valid data, coverage is 90%; unmeasured areas cannot count as defect-free.

checks.title: 背填證據工程移交~Backfill evidence and handover
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Unclosed ring balances require individual review.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10環中8環收支閉合且證據完整，覆蓋80%；其餘2環要逐環列出缺項與審查決定。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 8 of an assumed 10 rings have closed balances and complete evidence, coverage is 80%; the other 2 require individual gaps and review decisions.

checks.title: 始發到達控制體~Launch and reception control volumes
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Minimum stage redundancy cannot be represented by an average count.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設4個階段的獨立屏障數為2、1、2、2，最低為1；平均1.75不能代表關鍵階段冗餘。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed barrier counts 2,1,2 and 2 across four stages, the minimum is 1; the mean 1.75 does not describe redundancy at the critical transition.

checks.title: 水頭基準與外水力~Head datum and external water force
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Freshwater head difference and uniformly loaded plane area, not pressure-varying resultant.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation.

checks.title: 處理體連續性與薄弱通道~Treated-ground continuity and weak paths
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Series flow normal to two layers; harmonic mean fails for bypass paths.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設串聯兩層各厚1 m，k1=10⁻⁶、k2=10⁻⁸ m/s，法向等效k=2/(10⁶+10⁸)=1.98×10⁻⁸ m/s；旁通不適用。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume two 1 m layers in series with k1=10⁻⁶ and k2=10⁻⁸ m/s; normal equivalent k=1.98×10⁻⁸ m/s, excluding bypass paths.

checks.title: 滲流梯度與尺度~Seepage gradient and scale
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Effective shortest path, not automatically the nominal treatment thickness.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設水頭差10 m、有效路徑5 m，i=2；若裂縫路徑僅1 m則i=10，未計三維流場。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume head difference 10 m over effective path 5 m, giving i=2; a 1 m crack path gives i=10, before three-dimensional flow effects.

checks.title: 止水環壓縮與偏心~Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Geometric opposite compression; flexible seal response requires testing.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設名義壓縮12 mm、偏心4 mm，簡化兩側壓縮8與16 mm；實際柔性變形需試驗確認。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume nominal compression 12 mm and eccentricity 4 mm; simplified opposite compressions are 8 and 16 mm, with actual flexibility requiring testing.

checks.title: 角度誤差與穿越長度~Angular error through the opening
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Crossing length and angular-error geometry, not allowable angle.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設穿越長10 m、角偏0.2°，側向偏差10tan0.2°=34.91 mm；非允許偏角。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed crossing length 10 m and angular error 0.2°, lateral deviation is 10tan0.2°=34.91 mm, not an allowable angle.

checks.title: 反力架與暫態傳力~Reaction frame and temporary load paths
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Equal support stiffness assumed; actual eccentricity and gaps require analysis.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設反力4 MN由4個理想等剛度支點均分，平均1 MN/點；偏心及不等剛度須另算。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 4 MN reaction shared by 4 ideally equal-stiffness supports; the mean is 1 MN each, with eccentricity and stiffness differences assessed separately.

checks.title: 觀測鏈與過渡確認~Observation chains and transition checks
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Offline data must remain missing rather than filled with normal zeros.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設6項關鍵觀測中5項有效、1項失聯，有效率83.3%；失聯不能填成正常零值。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 5 of an assumed 6 critical observations are valid and 1 is offline, validity is 83.3%; missing data must not be filled as a normal zero.

checks.title: 停留情境與既定回應~Hold scenarios and predetermined responses
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Serial information-delay scale, not permissible engineering hold time.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設資料更新間隔2 min、傳輸3 min、確認5 min，單次資訊等待尺度10 min；不是允許停留時間。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume update interval 2 min, transmission 3 min and confirmation 5 min; information delay totals 10 min, not an allowable hold duration.

checks.title: 介面證據與接管~Interface evidence and takeover
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Unverified permanent interface remains open regardless of average completion.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10項永久交接條件有9項完成，90%不能取代尚未驗證的1項止水介面；逐項審查優先於平均。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 9 of an assumed 10 permanent handover conditions are complete, 90% cannot substitute for one unverified sealing interface; individual review takes precedence over the average.

checks.title: 控制網與坐標基準~Control networks and coordinate datum
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Scale error grows with origin distance; not random instrument error.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設本地點距轉換原點1000 m，尺度錯誤10 ppm產生10 mm位置差；非儀器隨機誤差。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At an assumed distance 1000 m from a transformation origin, a 10 ppm scale error creates 10 mm position error, not random instrument noise.

checks.title: 方位精度與遠距傳遞~Azimuth precision over distance
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Arcsecond conversion and small-angle transverse scale; station errors excluded.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設視距300 m、角度誤差1.5 arcsec，側向尺度300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm；未含設站誤差。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume sight distance 300 m and angular error 1.5 arcsec; lateral scale is 300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm, excluding station error.

checks.title: 陀螺定向與漂移~Gyro orientation and drift
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Small-angle projection of direction bias.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設方向偏差0.001 rad，在100 m投影造成約100 mm側移；小角近似e=Lθ。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume direction bias 0.001 rad; projection over 100 m gives approximately 100 mm lateral error through e=Lθ.

checks.title: 目標桿臂與機身姿態~Target lever arms and machine attitude
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Rotating lever-arm correction, not fixed translation.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設目標距刀盤中心10 m、偏航0.1°，橫向桿臂修正10sin0.1°=17.45 mm；非可忽略常數。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume target-to-cutterhead lever arm 10 m and yaw 0.1°; lateral correction is 10sin0.1°=17.45 mm, not a negligible constant.

checks.title: 設計線形與里程投影~Design alignment and chainage projection
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Horizontal chainage differs from slope distance.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設水平前進100 m、縱坡2%，高程變化2 m，斜長√(100²+2²)=100.020 m；里程定義須明示。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 100 m horizontal advance on a 2% grade; elevation changes 2 m and slope length is 100.020 m, requiring an explicit chainage convention.

checks.title: 曲線組環與楔形量~Curved ring building and taper
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Short-arc curvature illustration, not ring/steering acceptance.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設環寬1.5 m、曲率半徑300 m，每環轉角約L/R=0.005 rad=0.286°；為小角近似。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume ring width 1.5 m and curvature radius 300 m; turn per ring is approximately L/R=0.005 rad=0.286°, a small-angle approximation.

checks.title: 尾隙與機器環片相對位移~Relative machine-ring clearance
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Relative machine-ring eccentricity differs from absolute alignment offset.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設機器中心右偏12 mm、環中心右偏5 mm，相對偏心7 mm；不能用12 mm直接當尾隙偏差。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume machine center 12 mm right and ring center 5 mm right; relative eccentricity is 7 mm, not the full 12 mm machine offset.

checks.title: 折射環境與品質旗標~Refraction environment and quality flags
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Independent standard uncertainties; no automatic normal-significance claim.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩次同點讀值相差6 mm、各標準不確定2 mm且獨立，差值標準不確定2.83 mm，差約2.12倍。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Two assumed observations differ by 6 mm with independent 2 mm standard uncertainties each; difference uncertainty is 2.83 mm and the discrepancy is about 2.12 times it.

checks.title: 資料融合與共同偏差~Data fusion and common bias
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Independent unbiased measurements of same quantity; shared biases invalidate reduction.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設獨立標準不確定2與3 mm，融合u=1/√(1/2²+1/3²)=1.664 mm；有共同偏差時不適用。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed independent standard uncertainties 2 and 3 mm, fused u=1/√(1/2²+1/3²)=1.664 mm, inapplicable to a shared bias.

checks.title: 貫通檢核與竣工交接~Breakthrough checks and as-built handover
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Author clarified standard-uncertainty components of independent zero-mean errors; raw signed offsets and systematic bias are not combined by this RSS.
checks.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設獨立零均值橫向隨機誤差的標準不確定度分量10、12、9 mm，RSS=√(100+144+81)=18.03 mm；系統偏差另列。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume standard-uncertainty components of independent zero-mean lateral errors of 10,12 and 9 mm; RSS=√(100+144+81)=18.03 mm, with systematic biases reported separately.

checks.title: 伸縮行程與循環約束~Telescopic travel and cycle constraint
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Integer ring count uses usable stroke after reserved travel.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m.

checks.title: 撐靴接觸與局部岩壁~Gripper contact and local rock wall
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Nominal contact stress, not allowable ground pressure.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設法向合力8 MN、有效面積4 m²，平均壓力8/4=2 MPa；若有效接觸只剩2 m²，平均壓力變成4 MPa，均非容許值。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume normal force 8 MN over effective area 4 m²: mean pressure is 8/4=2 MPa. Reducing effective contact to 2 m² raises it to 4 MPa. Neither is an allowable value.

checks.title: 反力摩擦與需求分離~Reaction friction versus demand
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Ideal friction estimate, not code safety factor.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設N=8 MN、摩擦係數μ=0.4，軸向摩擦估計μN=3.2 MN；若假設軸向需求2.8 MN，比值3.2/2.8=1.14，非設計安全係數。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume N=8 MN and friction coefficient μ=0.4. Estimated axial friction is μN=3.2 MN. Against an assumed demand of 2.8 MN, the ratio is 3.2/2.8=1.14, not a design safety factor.

checks.title: 襯砌反力與局部承壓~Lining reaction and local bearing
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Equal shoe distribution omits segment bending and nonuniform contacts.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總推力12 MN由24個推靴平均承擔，各為0.5 MN；每個有效面積0.1 m²，名義承壓0.5/0.1=5 MPa，未檢查管片彎裂。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 12 MN shared equally by 24 shoes: each carries 0.5 MN. With effective area 0.1 m² per shoe, nominal bearing is 0.5/0.1=5 MPa. Segment bending and cracking are not checked.

checks.title: 並行工序與關鍵循環~Parallel tasks and critical cycle
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Perfect independent overlap; regrip remains serial.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設切削30 min、組環25 min、定位5 min，每環並行循環max(30,25)+5=35 min；順序循環為60 min，理想時間節省25/60=41.7%。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume cutting 30 min, assembly 25 min and regripping 5 min. A parallel cycle is max(30,25)+5=35 min versus 60 min sequentially; ideal time saving is 25/60=41.7%.

checks.title: 盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力~Shield contact and squeezing resistance
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Uniform normal contact pressure and assumed friction coefficient.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設D=6 m、接觸L=4 m、p=0.2 MPa、μ=0.3，F=μpπDL=4.52 MN；L變為6 m時F=6.79 MN，均為理想均壓摩擦。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume D=6 m, contact length L=4 m, p=0.2 MPa and μ=0.3. Uniform-contact friction is F=μpπDL=4.52 MN; at L=6 m it becomes 6.79 MN.

checks.title: 姿態差與推力偏心~Attitude difference and thrust eccentricity
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Geometric differential stroke, not steering instruction.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設左右量測基距B=5 m、行程差Δ=10 mm=0.010 m，小角θ≈Δ/B=0.002 rad=0.115°；並非允許導向角。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume lateral baseline B=5 m and differential travel Δ=10 mm=0.010 m. The small angle is θ≈Δ/B=0.002 rad=0.115°, not an allowable steering angle.

checks.title: 切削能量與岩況判讀~Cutting energy and ground interpretation
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Mean mechanical energy boundary retained; individual losses not separately inferred.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設平均機械功率800 kW、有效切削0.5 h、開挖40 m³，E/V=800×0.5/40=10 kWh/m³=36 MJ/m³，未扣除各項損失。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mean mechanical power 800 kW, cutting duration 0.5 h and excavation 40 m³. E/V=800×0.5/40=10 kWh/m³=36 MJ/m³, before separating individual losses.

checks.title: 停機利用率與敏感度~Downtime utilization and sensitivity
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Utilization fraction and working-day denominator explicit.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設貫入5 mm/rev、2 rev/min、排程20 h/day、利用率0.5，進尺=5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day；利用率0.4時為4.8 m/day。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume penetration 5 mm/rev, 2 rev/min, schedule 20 h/day and utilization 0.5. Advance is 5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day; utilization 0.4 gives 4.8 m/day.

checks.title: 環號追溯與缺測處理~Ring traceability and missing observations
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Unresolved handover records remain unresolved.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設交接要求120個關鍵事件記錄，已驗證114個，完整率114/120=95%；仍有6個未閉合事件，不能以平均完整率取代逐項追查。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume handover requires 120 critical event records and 114 are verified. Completeness is 114/120=95%, leaving six unresolved events; the average percentage cannot replace investigation of each missing item.

checks.title: 頂拱岩塊與自重路徑~Crown blocks and self-weight path
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Self-weight of assumed block is not bolt demand or sliding check.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設塊體體積V=2.4 m³、岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=62.4 kN；這不是單一錨栓的需求，也未檢核滑動面。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume block volume V=2.4 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Weight is W=γV=62.4 kN; this is not an individual bolt demand and does not check a sliding surface.

checks.title: 未支護距離與時間窗~Unsupported distance and exposure time
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Exposure duration is not stand-up-time capacity.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設支護落後距離6 m、平均有效前進0.8 m/h，時間窗6/0.8=7.5 h；速度降為0.4 m/h時為15 h，非允許自立時間。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume support lags 6 m and effective advance averages 0.8 m/h. Exposure time is 6/0.8=7.5 h; at 0.4 m/h it becomes 15 h. These are not allowable stand-up times.

checks.title: 錨栓方向與抗力分量~Bolt direction and force component
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Projected ideal bolt forces, no automatic design allowance.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設四支錨栓各提供60 kN軸向力，與所需方向夾角30°，合分量4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN；不代表設計容許抗力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume four bolts each develop 60 kN axially at 30° to the required direction. Their combined component is 4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN, not a design allowable resistance.

checks.title: 噴層厚度與局部彎曲~Sprayed-layer thickness and local bending
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Elastic one-metre strip stress; tension/cracking requires separate assessment.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設寬b=1 m、厚t=0.12 m、彎矩M=2 kN·m，彈性應力6M/(bt²)=833 kPa=0.833 MPa；t降至0.10 m時為1.2 MPa。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume width b=1 m, thickness t=0.12 m and moment M=2 kN·m. Elastic stress 6M/(bt²)=833 kPa=0.833 MPa; reducing t to 0.10 m gives 1.2 MPa.

checks.title: 支護滯後的梁式敏感度~Beam sensitivity to support lag
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Simply supported uniform-load elastic beam only.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設均布q=20 kN/m、EI=50000 kN·m²，L=3 m時δ=5qL⁴/(384EI)=0.422 mm；L=4 m時為1.333 mm，為原值3.16倍。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform q=20 kN/m and EI=50000 kN·m². At L=3 m, δ=5qL⁴/(384EI)=0.422 mm; at L=4 m it is 1.333 mm, a factor of 3.16.

checks.title: 收斂速率與時間解析~Convergence rate and time resolution
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Independent reading uncertainty; trend does not establish cause.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同一測線收斂由8 mm增至11 mm、間隔6 h，平均速率(11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h；若讀值獨立標準差各0.3 mm，差值標準差為0.424 mm。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume convergence rises from 8 to 11 mm over 6 h: mean rate is (11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h. With independent reading standard deviations of 0.3 mm, difference uncertainty is 0.424 mm.

checks.title: 超挖體積與出碴核對~Overbreak volume and muck reconciliation
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: In-situ geometric excess, not loose spoil volume.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義D=6 m、實測等效D=6.1 m、段長L=2 m，超挖V=π(6.1²-6²)×2/4=1.901 m³；這是原位體積而非鬆方。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal D=6 m, equivalent measured D=6.1 m and length L=2 m. Overbreak is V=π(6.1²-6²)×2/4=1.901 m³ of in-situ ground, not loose muck.

checks.title: 運碴能力與積存狀態~Mucking capacity and accumulation
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Fixed loose-volume production/removal and finite buffer.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同基準鬆方產生率80 m³/h、移除率65 m³/h，持續2 h增加(80-65)×2=30 m³；若可用暫存20 m³，理想填滿時間20/15=1.33 h。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume loose-volume generation 80 m³/h and removal 65 m³/h on the same basis. Two hours add 30 m³; a 20 m³ free buffer fills ideally in 20/15=1.33 h.

checks.title: 環境量測的換氣尺度~Ventilation mixing-time scale
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Ideal completely mixed clean-air replacement, no continuing source; not access permission.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設有效體積V=600 m³、潔淨風量Q=20 m³/s，時間常數τ=V/Q=30 s；無持續污染源時90%衰減需ln(10)τ=69.1 s。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume effective volume V=600 m³ and clean airflow Q=20 m³/s. Time constant τ=V/Q=30 s; with no continuing source, 90% decay requires ln(10)τ=69.1 s.

checks.title: 支護交接與抽驗代表性~Support handover and sampling coverage
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Sample fractions do not justify population failure prevalence.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設100個支護記錄中抽驗20個，覆蓋率20%；若10個異常區記錄僅抽1個，異常區覆蓋率為10%，不能由總體20%推定同等覆蓋。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 20 of 100 support records are checked: coverage is 20%. If only one of ten anomalous-zone records is checked, that zone has 10% coverage, not the overall 20%.

checks.title: 地層支護曲線交點~Ground-support curve intersection
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Linear ground/support illustration within u>=10 and positive ground pressure.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u以mm計，pg=0.6-0.02u MPa、ps=0.01(u-10) MPa且u≥10；相等得u=23.33 mm、p=0.133 MPa，僅為線性示例。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume displacement u in mm, pg=0.6-0.02u MPa and ps=0.01(u-10) MPa for u≥10. Equating them gives u=23.33 mm and p=0.133 MPa, a linear illustration only.

checks.title: 分部面積與暴露尺度~Subdivided area and exposure scale
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Area/volume partition does not establish load share or stability.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總斷面80 m²分為30、30、20 m²三部分，最大單部面積30/80=37.5%；每次假設進尺1 m時，最大單部原位開挖30 m³。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an 80 m² section divided into 30, 30 and 20 m² parts. The largest part is 30/80=37.5%; at an assumed 1 m increment its in-situ excavation is 30 m³.

checks.title: 早齡受壓與強度發展~Early-age compression and strength development
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Unit-width axial stress and synthetic strength; no factors or bending.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設軸力N=300 kN/m、厚t=0.20 m，單位寬平均應力N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa；若合成試驗強度2 MPa，比值為0.75，未含分項係數。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume axial force N=300 kN/m and thickness t=0.20 m. Unit-width mean stress N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa. Against synthetic test strength 2 MPa, the ratio is 0.75 before any partial factors.

checks.title: 薄弱截面與偏心彎曲~Weak sections and eccentric bending
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Elastic full-section stress; negative edge tension identified.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設每米寬N=200 kN、M=10 kN·m、t=0.25 m，σ=N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa，兩緣為1.76與-0.16 MPa，負值表示拉應力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. For a 1 m strip assume N=200 kN, M=10 kN·m and t=0.25 m. Stress is N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa: edges are 1.76 and -0.16 MPa, with negative indicating tension.

checks.title: 仰拱閉合與剛度改變~Invert closure and stiffness change
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Prescribed equivalent incremental stiffness, not field calibration.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同一增量荷載ΔF=600 kN，開口等效剛度20 kN/mm、閉合後60 kN/mm，位移增量分別30與10 mm；兩剛度均為教學假設。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume the same incremental force ΔF=600 kN. With equivalent stiffness 20 kN/mm before closure and 60 kN/mm after, displacement increments are 30 and 10 mm; both stiffnesses are teaching assumptions.

checks.title: 施工時間與剛度相容~Construction timing and stiffness compatibility
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Elastic axial illustration excludes creep and shrinkage.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設單位寬A=0.25 m²、N=300 kN，E=6 GPa時ε=N/(EA)=200微應變；E=12 GPa時為100微應變，未包含徐變與收縮。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume unit-width area A=0.25 m² and N=300 kN. At E=6 GPa, ε=N/(EA)=200 microstrain; at E=12 GPa it is 100 microstrain, excluding creep and shrinkage.

checks.title: 收斂曲線與外推界線~Convergence curves and extrapolation limits
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Assumed exponential asymptote is not a field limit.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm，t以day計，u(5)=12.64 mm、u(10)=17.29 mm；極限20 mm只是模型參數，非現場允收限值。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm with t in days. Values are u(5)=12.64 mm and u(10)=17.29 mm; the 20 mm asymptote is a model parameter, not a field acceptance limit.

checks.title: 防水介面與壓力分布~Waterproofing interfaces and pressure distribution
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Local plane area with uniform gauge pressure, not whole curved lining resultant.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設均勻表壓p=150 kPa作用於局部平面A=2 m²，合力F=pA=300 kN；這是假設局部均壓，非整個彎曲襯砌的總合力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform gauge pressure p=150 kPa on local plane area A=2 m². Resultant F=pA=300 kN applies to this idealized local patch, not the entire curved lining.

checks.title: 反分析的多解問題~Non-uniqueness in back-analysis
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Single displacement cannot identify force and stiffness independently.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u=F/k=10 mm，可由F=500 kN、k=50 kN/mm，也可由F=1000 kN、k=100 kN/mm得到；一個位移觀測無法區分兩組。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. An observed u=F/k=10 mm can arise from F=500 kN with k=50 kN/mm or F=1000 kN with k=100 kN/mm. One displacement observation cannot distinguish the two pairs.

checks.title: 分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖~Layered-lining handover and defect map
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Critical joint defect cannot be averaged away by sound area.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設檢查面積200 m²、已確認需處置區8 m²，面積比8/200=4%；若其中2 m²位於關鍵接縫，不能被其餘192 m²良好區平均掉。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume inspected area 200 m² and confirmed treatment area 8 m²: the fraction is 8/200=4%. If 2 m² lies at critical joints, the 192 m² of satisfactory area cannot average that issue away.

checks.title: 上半斷面與反力位置~Upper section and reaction locations
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Symmetric versus hypothetical asymmetric reaction allocation.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設垂直合力W=900 kN且對稱，左右反力各450 kN；若假設分配為60%與40%，則為540及360 kN，總和仍為900 kN。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume vertical resultant W=900 kN. Symmetry gives 450 kN at each side. A hypothetical 60/40 split instead gives 540 and 360 kN, still summing to 900 kN.

checks.title: 台階長度與暴露歷程~Bench length and exposure history
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Fixed moving separation; duration is not allowable wait.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設兩作業點穩定相距12 m、同步平均推進2 m/day，一斷面等待時間12/2=6 days；加入3天停頓則為9 days，非允許等待期。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume two work points remain 12 m apart while advancing at 2 m/day. A section waits 12/2=6 days; a three-day shutdown makes nine days. Neither is an allowable waiting period.

checks.title: 拱腳面積與接觸承壓~Arch-foot area and contact bearing
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Mean contact pressure before bearing and settlement assessment.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設反力R=600 kN、有效接觸A=1.2 m²，平均q=500 kPa；若接觸降為0.8 m²，q=750 kPa，未檢查地層承載或沉陷。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume reaction R=600 kN and effective contact A=1.2 m². Mean bearing q=500 kPa; with A=0.8 m² it becomes 750 kPa, without checking ground capacity or settlement.

checks.title: 保留核心與幾何邊界~Retained core and geometric boundaries
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Core volume fraction is not resistance fraction.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設整段面積60 m²、長4 m，總體積240 m³；保留核心面積12 m²同長，體積48 m³，占20%，未代表提供20%抗力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume total area 60 m² over 4 m, giving 240 m³. A retained core of 12 m² over the same length occupies 48 m³ or 20%, which does not mean it supplies 20% resistance.

checks.title: 左右下挖與差異沉陷~Asymmetric lower excavation and settlement
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Small rigid-body rotation, not structural distortion capacity.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設左右拱腳相距6 m、沉陷差4 mm=0.004 m，剛體小轉角θ≈0.004/6=0.000667 rad=0.0382°，並非容許變形值。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume feet are 6 m apart with differential settlement 4 mm=0.004 m. Rigid-body small rotation θ≈0.004/6=0.000667 rad=0.0382°, not an allowable deformation.

checks.title: 開挖與出碴質量帳~Excavation and muck mass accounting
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Mass conserved, loose volume separated by assumed bulking factor.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設下半面積25 m²、進尺1.5 m、原位密度2400 kg/m³，質量25×1.5×2400=90000 kg=90 t；假設鬆方係數1.4時體積為52.5 m³。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume lower area 25 m², advance 1.5 m and in-situ density 2400 kg/m³. Mass is 90000 kg=90 t. With assumed bulking factor 1.4, loose volume is 52.5 m³.

checks.title: 閉合追趕與相對速度~Closure catch-up and relative speed
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Constant-speed catch-up; equal speeds never close gap.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設初始落後20 m，上半前進2 m/day、仰拱完成3 m/day，縮短速度1 m/day，理想追平需20 days；若兩者皆2 m/day則距離不縮小。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an initial 20 m gap, upper advance 2 m/day and invert completion 3 m/day. The gap shrinks at 1 m/day, requiring 20 days ideally; equal 2 m/day speeds never close it.

checks.title: 測量閉合與基準誤差~Survey closure and reference uncertainty
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Independent noise averages; common bias remains.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設四次獨立讀值各標準差1 mm，平均標準差1/√4=0.5 mm；若另有共用基準偏差2 mm，它仍為2 mm，不隨四次平均消失。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume four independent readings each with standard deviation 1 mm. Their mean has 1/√4=0.5 mm standard deviation. A shared 2 mm reference bias remains 2 mm despite averaging.

checks.title: 台階排水與滲流邊界~Bench drainage and seepage boundaries
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Darcy idealization with fixed k and flow geometry.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設k=0.0001 m/s、A=15 m²、Δh=8 m、L=12 m，Q=kAΔh/L=0.001 m³/s=3.6 m³/h；水頭差減半則Q減半。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume k=0.0001 m/s, A=15 m², Δh=8 m and L=12 m. Q=kAΔh/L=0.001 m³/s=3.6 m³/h; halving head difference halves this ideal flow.

checks.title: 閉合後淨空與驗收餘量~Post-closure clearance and acceptance allowance
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Geometric remainder excludes future deformation reserve.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設實測高度5.20 m、所需高度5.05 m、保守量測扣減0.03 m，剩餘餘量5.20-5.05-0.03=0.12 m；未含未來變形預留。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume measured height 5.20 m, required height 5.05 m and conservative measurement deduction 0.03 m. Remaining allowance is 0.12 m, before reserving future movement.

checks.title: 分割跨度與梁式比較~Subdivided span and beam comparison
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Uniform load and simple supports must remain the same.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設q=30 kN/m、L=8 m，M=qL²/8=240 kN·m；將理想跨度減為4 m則M=60 kN·m，僅適用相同均布與簡支邊界。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume q=30 kN/m and L=8 m. M=qL²/8=240 kN·m; an ideal 4 m span gives 60 kN·m, under the same uniform loading and simple-support boundaries only.

checks.title: 左右偏載與合力位置~Left-right loading and resultant position
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Resultant location and eccentricity; no stress adequacy implied.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設截面寬12 m，向下力600 kN位於x=2 m、400 kN位於x=10 m，合力位置x=(600×2+400×10)/1000=5.2 m，偏中心0.8 m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a 12 m section with downward forces 600 kN at x=2 m and 400 kN at x=10 m. Resultant x=(600×2+400×10)/1000=5.2 m, 0.8 m from center.

checks.title: 暫時牆細長與理想屈曲~Temporary-wall slenderness and ideal buckling
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Euler ideal pinned elastic column excludes imperfections and inelasticity.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設兩端鉸接、EI=20000 kN·m²、有效H=6 m，Pcr=π²EI/H²=5483 kN；H增至9 m則2437 kN，未含初始缺陷或非彈性。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume pinned ends, EI=20000 kN·m² and effective H=6 m. Pcr=π²EI/H²=5483 kN; at H=9 m it is 2437 kN, excluding imperfections and inelastic behavior.

checks.title: 中隔牆偏心與拉壓邊緣~Wall eccentricity and edge stresses
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Elastic one-metre strip, tensile edge identified, no cracked-section capacity claim.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設單位寬N=500 kN、e=0.10 m、t=0.30 m，M=50 kN·m；σ=N/t±6M/t²=1.667±3.333 MPa，兩緣5與-1.667 MPa。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. For a 1 m strip assume N=500 kN, eccentricity e=0.10 m and thickness t=0.30 m. M=50 kN·m; σ=N/t±6M/t²=1.667±3.333 MPa, giving 5 and -1.667 MPa at the edges.

checks.title: 支承剛度與荷載重分配~Support stiffness and load redistribution
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Parallel linear elements and force held fixed during removal.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總F=1000 kN、並聯k1=20及k2=30 kN/mm，位移20 mm、分力400與600 kN；移除k1後位移1000/30=33.33 mm。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume total F=1000 kN and parallel stiffnesses k1=20 and k2=30 kN/mm. Displacement is 20 mm and forces are 400 and 600 kN. Removing k1 gives 1000/30=33.33 mm.

checks.title: 暫時構件減少與需求缺口~Temporary-member reduction and demand gap
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Given independent same-direction resistance; factors/group effects excluded.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設四個獨立同向支承各有200 kN已給定能力，總800 kN；少一個後僅600 kN，對假設需求700 kN差100 kN，未含分項與群體效應。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume four independent supports with supplied same-direction resistance 200 kN each, totaling 800 kN. With one absent, 600 kN remains against assumed demand 700 kN, leaving a 100 kN gap before factors or group effects.

checks.title: 共同基準與相關誤差~Shared reference and correlated uncertainty
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Covariance applies to sum, not an unspecified difference.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設相加量兩項標準差2與3 mm、相關係數ρ=0.5，σ=√(2²+3²+2×0.5×2×3)=4.36 mm；若獨立則3.61 mm。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. For a sum, assume standard deviations 2 and 3 mm and correlation ρ=0.5. σ=√(2²+3²+2×0.5×2×3)=4.36 mm; independence would give 3.61 mm.

checks.title: 階段模型與保留驗證~Staged model and withheld validation
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Withheld observations; RMSE is not peak residual.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設三個保留觀測為4、7、10 mm，預測為5、7、8 mm，誤差為1、0、-2 mm，RMSE=√[(1²+0²+2²)/3]=1.29 mm。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume withheld observations 4, 7 and 10 mm with predictions 5, 7 and 8 mm. Errors are 1, 0 and -2 mm; RMSE=√[(1²+0²+2²)/3]=1.29 mm.

checks.title: 拆牆介面與水壓路徑~Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Plane local area; whole curved structure requires vector integration.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設淡水水頭18 m，p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa；在假設平面面積1.5 m²上F=264.87 kN，未代表整個曲面襯砌的合力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume freshwater head 18 m: p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa. On an ideal plane area 1.5 m², F=264.87 kN; this is not the resultant over the whole curved lining.

checks.title: 施工狀態清單與交接~Construction-state register and handover
checks.physicalBoundaryReview: Approval fraction cannot override unresolved load transfer.
checks.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設交接列80項界面，已核准76項，完成率76/80=95%；剩餘4項若含荷載轉移驗證，即使比例只有5%也不能自動結案。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 80 interface items with 76 approved: completion is 76/80=95%. If the remaining four include load-transfer verification, their 5% share does not justify automatic closure.
